qualityNotes: The 80 legacy machine-formatted dialogues were replaced with new APS practice wording rather than repaired word-by-word.
The 25 already-clean pilot/original dialogues were revalidated and terminology-normalised.
Stored alternative answers are examples, not a closed list; every segment carries meaning-first answer-flexibility metadata.

The offline scorer also normalises common Hindi/English synonyms and is insensitive to ordinary word-order changes; critical details such as numbers, names, negation, conditions and modality remain important.
Raw vocabulary entries from the large uploaded PDF are preserved for editorial reference but are not exposed as reviewed student vocabulary.
